title: Taprint Designer Message Protocol
$comment: Designer<->host postMessage contract, published with the designer's first release (v0.3, ADR-0011). Protocol version: 2 (the neutral-naming epoch) (ADR-0003): window.TaprintDesigner, __TAPRINT_TOKEN__, __TAPRINT_DESIGNER_CONFIG__, token channel messages 'taprint-token'/'taprint-token-expired', event 'taprint-token-injected', HKDF salt 'taprint-designer-v1'. No legacy aliases ship in this repository. Changes to this file must be mirrored in apps/designer/src/shared/protocol.ts (enum mirror is asserted by tests).

DesignerMessage.$comment: deviceClass/errorMessage accept explicit null — some host serializers emit null properties, so the schema must accept the exact wire shape; the web sender omits absent keys instead of sending null.

HostMessage.$comment: templateId/version/errorMessage/previewUrl accept explicit null — same serializer-alignment rationale as DesignerMessage.

type.$comment: closeRequest is delivered by the host when the embedded session must unwind (for example after a failed token refresh).

TemplateDSL.$comment: Placeholder type: deep DSL validation is not this protocol's job. Validation merges the template DSL schema matching the template's schemaVersion (see schema/v1.0.json..v2.0.json); the designer performs that validation in its own layer.
